Most businesses have years to earn a customer’s trust.
But the wedding industry is different. There is a relatively short window of opportunity for a couple to find you, trust you, and decide you’re the right fit.
They get engaged, start researching, create a shortlist, compare their options, ask friends for recommendations, scroll Instagram late at night, search Google, revisit the same websites... and eventually make a decision they’ll likely make only once.
That’s what makes wedding marketing so unique.
Couples don’t immediately book when they first discover your business.
They come across your business, keep exploring, come back a few days later, consume more of your content, search your name, compare a few options, and slowly become more confident in their decision.
That confidence is built one interaction at a time.
Some of those moments happen because a couple is actively searching.
Others happen because your business continues showing up while they’re deciding, reminding them who you are, what you offer, and why you stood out in the first place.
That’s why we love combining platforms that each support a different part of the journey.
Some platforms capture intent.
Others reinforce trust.
Couples need both before they book.
We break all of this down in more detail on the [@secretsofabridalseamstress](https://www.instagram.com/secretsofabridalseamstress/) podcast. Find the full episode at the link in our bio
